name: Gasthof Au
beschreibung: The Gasthof Au in Ellmau is a traditional inn located in the scenic Wilder Kaiser region. The accommodation enjoys a peaceful setting just off the beaten track. The property features well-maintained guest rooms with classic Tyrolean furnishings. In the on-site restaurant, delicious regional and seasonal dishes are served. The immediate surroundings are dominated by the spectacular mountain backdrop of the Wilder Kaiser. Hikers and mountain bikers can access numerous trails directly from the doorstep. In winter, the slopes of the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser – Brixental ski area are within easy reach. The interior decor harmoniously blends alpine charm with practical functionality.
